title: Token diet: shrink always-loaded context (memory indexes, skill list, dead board events, old worktrees)
description: Every session starts at ~99k tokens and re-sends it on ~112 requests. Cut the parts we own: global CLAUDE.md memory list (25 KB), project MEMORY.md (16 KB), unused repo skills + duplicate audit command, the dead board.json events key (312 KB), stale worktrees. Move durable codebase facts out of memory into docs/rules.
